title: Emerald Waters | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located off the iconic Scenic Highway 30A, this stunning Seacrest Beach retreat invites you to experience the ultimate Emerald Coast getaway. This three-level, dog-friendly home offers an ideal blend of modern luxury, beachside charm, and family-friendly amenities. With high ceilings, airy interiors, and private balconies, the home is designed for relaxation and connection. Whether you’re lounging after a sun-soaked day on the sugar-white sands or gathering for a cozy evening together, this spacious retreat ensures every guest finds their own corner of paradise. Walking distance to the beach and the area's largest resort-style pool, it’s perfectly positioned for unforgettable family memories. Nestled between the enchanting neighborhoods of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, this home provides easy access to the best of 30A living. Explore boutique shops, dine at local eateries, and enjoy vibrant entertainment just steps away. For outdoor enthusiasts, the private beach, nearby Camp Creek Golf Club, and the natural beauty of Camp Helen State Park offer endless adventures. Whether savoring your morning coffee on the balcony, strolling the pristine shoreline, or discovering the unique coastal towns along 30A, this property is your gateway to the relaxed elegance and unforgettable charm of the Emerald Coast.
